title: Fix SSH dir permissions test failing in containers

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Test 38 creates ~/.ssh in setup() without chmod, then checks permissions after apply_ssh_config. But apply_ssh_config only chmods if the dir doesn't exist. Fix: remove ~/.ssh before this test so apply_ssh_config creates it fresh with correct perms.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Fixed stat format detection — use if/else instead of || which fails under set -e. Also removed run wrapper for apply_ssh_config to avoid subshell issues.
